summary: Both blocking findings are valid migration-parity gaps. The spec needs explicit metadata owners for independent core commands and concrete help invocation ownership mapping.

items.title: Independent core commands have no metadata owner
items.rationale: The spec requires all current top-level core help entries to become metadata-derived, but it does not name owners for independent entrypoints outside allCommands.
items.evidence: spec.json currently names src/lib/command-registry.js for flow/docs/check/metrics/spec/hook but does not map help, setup, upgrade, plugin, or presets list.

items.title: Public help invocation surfaces are not mapped to renderer ownership
items.rationale: The spec lists broad help surfaces but does not assign concrete CLI invocations to shared renderer or unchanged owners.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements and acceptance criteria mention core/plugin command help generally but do not map senti help, namespace --help, leaf --help, or direct plugin --help behavior.
